shortDescription: Diesel is selling for $9.99 a gallon at a fuel station in San Diego, according to Bloomberg. The article says Californians can at least take solace that, in theory, prices cannot get worse.

title: California Diesel Hits $9.99 a Gallon at San Diego Station
